values.note: recreation.gov's rate table (the Scan & Pay channel the forest now requires) charges $10 a night ('PeakCampground(Primitive)', 2026-10-01 to 2026-12-31); the forest's own page still says '$3 per vehicle, per night'.

fees.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10391783/rates (Peak Season 2026-10-01 - 2026-12-31, PeakCampground(Primitive) $10) + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r08/florida/recreation/hickory-landing ('THIS IS NOW A REC.GOV "SCAN & PAY" SITE'; 'Fee Site and Info $3 per vehicle, per night'), read 2026-10-21

hookups.source: recreation.gov campsite search for asset 10391783 (the one campsite record: 'STANDARD NONELECTRIC'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: recreation.gov notice: 'Artesian well at site.' The forest page lists 'Drinking water' among amenities but also says 'Potable water is not available at this site.'

facilities.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10391783 (amenities 'Vault Toilets', 'Boat Ramp', 'Grills', 'Picnic Tables', 'Tent Pads'; notice 'Artesian well at site.') + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r08/florida/recreation/hickory-landing ('Toilets (vault toilets)'; 'Potable water is not available at this site.'), read 2026-10-21

season.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r08/florida/recreation/hickory-landing ('Site is open to ALL campers year round'; 'Operational Hours: Open year round'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: First-come; pay on site through the recreation.gov app's Scan & Pay ('S&P Only'). Download the app before arriving, since cell service may be missing; the QR code is on the site's kiosk.

booking.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r08/florida/recreation/hickory-landing ('THIS IS NOW A REC.GOV "SCAN & PAY" SITE ** Download the Rec.gov App to your mobile device BEFORE visiting the Forest. Cellular service may not be available in some remote areas') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10391783 (facility_rules scanAndPay 'S&P Only'), read 2026-10-21

note: USFS campground near Sumatra among cypress stands on Owl Creek, with picnic tables, grills and a boat ramp with trailer parking; a 2-mile paddle to the Apalachicola River and access to the Wright Lake Trail. --Claude
summary: Forest page + recreation.gov: confirmed 10 sites, no electric, no potable water, first-come, year-round. Changed fees $3 -> $10 (rec.gov Scan & Pay rate from 2026-10-01; forest page still says $3), vault_toilets false -> true. Note cleaned (the 'no restrooms', '$3', 'not on recreation.gov' lines are wrong now; hookups/FCFS/RV Life redundant).
